Text: Place this on a foe's personality card. Reset the personality's anger to 0. It cannot go up until after he forces another player to discard a life card. Discard this from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: The Tail Grows Back
Text: Increase the personality's power stage to its maximum level. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: The Untroubled Mind is Focused
Text: Remove someone else's drill card or ally from the game. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Tien (SS Lv1)
Text: Multiform allows for two physical attacks one after another or a defense against a physical attack preventing 4 power stages of successful damage.

name: Tien (SS Lv2)
Text: Solar Flare Energy Attack. If successful your opponent Skips their next attacker's attack's phase.

name: Tien Mind Reading Trick
Text: Attach this to your opponent's Main Personality. If Tien is in play, all villain opponents must play with their hands face up on the table.

name: Tien's Energy Defense
Text: Prevents a foe's energy attack.

name: Tien's Physical Attack
Text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards draws if successful.

name: Unexpected Allies
Text: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for an Ally and put him into play at his highest power stage.

name: Unselfish Behavior is the Best
Text: The efforts of your allies stop this combat. You must have an ally out on the table to use this card. Discard from the game after use.

name: Vegeta (SS Lv1)
Text: Saiyan Energy Deflection: Reduce the damage from an energy attack performed against you to 2 life cards of damage.

name: Vegeta (SS Lv2)
Text: Saiyan Energy Blast does 3 life card draws of damage and costs only 1 power stage to perform.

name: Vegeta (SS Lv3)
Text: Captures one Dragon Ball once per game after a successful energy attack. This ends the combat step.

name: Vegeta (SS Lv4)
Text: Vegeta's laugh reduces a foe's power rating by 3 or to 0, which ever happens first.

name: Vegeta HT (SS Lv1)
Text: Stop an energy attack.

name: Vegeta's Dragon Ball Capture
Text: Capture 2 of a foe's Dragon Balls and place them at the bottom of his life deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Vegeta's Energy Blast
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Use when needed. This must be your first card played during Combat. Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Remove from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Physical Stance
Text: Stops a physical attack. Stops all physical attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Vegeta's Plans
Text: Get a Dragon Ball card from the life deck and put it into play. Remove from the game after one use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Vegeta's Quickness Drill
Text: At the beginning of each combat, draw 1 card from the bottom of the discard pile to use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Vegeta's Stance
Text: Prevents all but 1 life card draw from a successful energy attack. Discard from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Surprise Defense
Text: Stop one physical or energy attack from doing damage. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Trick
Text: Reveal cards from your opponents life deck until they reveal a Dragon Ball and set it aside. Shuffle your opponent's life deck. Then, if you revealed a Dragon Ball this way, place it on the bottom of its owners life deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Yajirobe (SS Lv1)
Text: Physical Attack.

name: Yajirobe (SS Lv2)
Text: Energy Attack needs 3 power stages to perform.

name: Yajirobe's Energy Attack
Text: Energy attack forcing 1 draw from the life deck if not stopped. Remove from the game after use.

name: Yajirobe's Physical Attack
Text: Physical attack doing 2 draws from the life deck if not stopped. Remove from the game after use.

name: Yamcha (SS Lv1)
Text: Energy attack doing 2 life cards of damage.

name: Yamcha (SS Lv2)
Text: Solar Flare Energy Attack. If successful your opponent Skips their next attacker's attack's phase.

name: Yamcha's Energy Attack
Text: Energy attack doing 2 life card draws of damage, costs 3 power stages to perform.

name: Yamcha's Physical Defense
Text: Prevents 3 life cards from being taken in a successful physical attack.
